profiles.name: Bajaj Finserv — Personal Loan
profiles.description: Unsecured personal loans offered by Bajaj Finance Limited.

contentGuidelines.toneOfVoice: Clear, warm and trustworthy. Explain like a helpful relationship manager, not a salesperson.
contentGuidelines.readabilityLevel: Class 8 reading level in Indian English; explain every financial term the first time it appears.
contentGuidelines.paragraphConstraints: Maximum 3 sentences (about 60 words) per paragraph. One idea per paragraph.
formattingRules: Write amounts with the ₹ symbol and Indian numbering (lakh, crore), e.g. ₹5 lakh.
Write rates as "% p.a." and say whether they are fixed or floating.
Put fees and charges in a table with a "subject to change" note.
Open every H2 with a one or two sentence direct answer.
Use numbered steps for application and documentation processes.
contentGuidelines.grammarAndPerspective: Second person ("you", "your"), active voice, present tense.
contentGuidelines.ctaStandards: Specific, honest CTAs: "Check your eligibility", "Apply online", "Calculate your EMI", "Read the Key Fact Statement".
contentGuidelines.citationFormatting: Name the source in the sentence (e.g. "as per RBI guidelines") and link to the official page.
contentGuidelines.customContentRules: Never state a rate, fee, limit, tenure or approval time that is not on the current approved rate card. Keep mandatory disclaimers next to the claims they qualify.

productGuidelines.toneOfVoice: Clear, reassuring, transparent and respectful; never pushy.
productGuidelines.targetAudience: Salaried and self-employed individuals in India planning a large expense or consolidating debt.
productGuidelines.complianceNotes: Name the lender as "Bajaj Finance Limited" (an RBI-registered NBFC) where the lending entity is referenced; keep product names that contain "Bajaj Finserv" unchanged. Interest rates, fees and charges must be quoted only from the current approved rate card and described as "subject to change". Where rates are discussed, refer readers to the Key Fact Statement (KFS) and Annual Percentage Rate (APR). Loan approval is at the lender's discretion and subject to eligibility and documentation. Link to the grievance redressal page; mention the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme where escalation is discussed.
productGuidelines.eeatCredentials: Lender: Bajaj Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company registered with the Reserve Bank of India.

seoGuidelines.headingHierarchyRules: H1 with primary entity name, H2 with question + topical modifier, H3 with evidence and data attribution.
seoGuidelines.sitemapGuidelines: Daily changefreq, lastmod ISO-8601 timestamps, image tags included.
seoGuidelines.customRules: Structured credentials, publication date, reviewer bio, and statutory licenses must be declared in JSON-LD and page markup.

geoGuidelines.llmCitationStrategy: Anchor authoritative source name, publication date, and methodology immediately following any numerical or regulatory claim.
geoGuidelines.entityDensityAndSchema: Connect Primary Entity to parent Knowledge Graph entity using sameAs Wikidata and Crunchbase links.
geoGuidelines.brandQuotationStandard: Incorporate verified corporate statements or executive quotes with credential attribution.
geoGuidelines.sourceVerificationStyle: Direct inline citations linked to primary governmental, academic, or industry benchmark sources.
geoGuidelines.customGeoRules: Inject high-density factual answers in the first 45 words of every major section.
geoGuidelines.statDensityRequirement: At least 1 verified metric or statistic per 150 words of body content.
geoGuidelines.directAnswerStandard: 40-50 word Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF) direct answers answering user search intent.
geoGuidelines.sourceAttributionStandard: Formal regulatory, academic, or certified third-party audit reports.
geoGuidelines.multiPerspectiveRequirement: Present structured comparison matrices or tables for LLM citation extraction.

customerCentricityGuidelines.targetCustomerPersona: Credit-conscious consumers and families navigating critical financial or life decisions.
customerCentricityGuidelines.empathyAndTone: Reassuring, compassionate, transparent, and non-judgmental. Eliminate sales pressure.
customerCentricityGuidelines.readingAccessibility: 8th-Grade layman readability (Flesch-Kincaid 60-70). Explain every financial/technical acronym immediately.
corePainPointsToAddress: Fear of hidden origination or processing fees
Anxiety about credit score hit during rate checks
Unclear repayment schedules or compounding interest
Unresponsive customer support during urgent disputes
frictionPatternsToFlag: Buried fee disclosures or asterisks without direct explanation
Aggressive countdown/false scarcity timers
Vague APR claims like "Rates as low as...*" without typical ranges
Complex run-on multi-clause sentences (>20 words)
Missing human contact phone or dispute assistance details
customerCentricityGuidelines.decisionJourneyOrder: 1. Soft-Check Reassurance -> 2. Transparent Cost Calculator -> 3. Simple 3-Step Process -> 4. Clear FAQ & Human Support Access
objectionHandlingRules: Proactively explain eligibility if credit score is below average
Directly state there are zero penalties for early prepayment or payoff
Clarify state licensing, security standards, and FDIC/partner bank backing
trustAndReassuranceSignals: "No impact on credit score" soft check badge
256-bit SSL bank-grade security encryption
Dedicated toll-free human phone support with hours
BBB / Trustpilot verified rating badge
Full statutory licensing & APR disclosure block
customerCentricityGuidelines.customCustomerRules: Every rate quote must display an illustrative APR example with representative loan terms and total repayment calculation.

preferredSectionOrder: Frequent Voice Questions & Direct BLUF Answers (H2)
structureMappingGuidelines.searchIntentMappingStrategy: Primary high-volume commercial keywords mapped to H1 and first H2; secondary informational and voice question long-tail keywords mapped to H3 FAQ sections.
structureMappingGuidelines.keywordDistributionRules: Primary target keyword in H1, first paragraph, and at least one H2. Target secondary keywords distributed evenly across body sub-sections with no clustering.
structureMappingGuidelines.customStructureRules: Every question-based H2/H3 heading must be immediately followed by a concise 40-50 word direct answer paragraph suitable for voice assistants.

guidelines.eeatCredentials: Distributor: Bajaj Finance Limited, registered with IRDAI as a corporate agent. Insurer: as named on each plan.

guidelines.toneOfVoice: Clear, reassuring, transparent and respectful; never pushy.
guidelines.targetAudience: First-time and experienced investors exploring SIPs, lump-sum investments and fund categories.
guidelines.complianceNotes: Include the SEBI-mandated disclaimer: "Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks, read all scheme related documents carefully." Past performance must be labelled as not indicative of future returns. Do not project returns. Name the AMC for each scheme.

seo.name: Strict YMYL & LLM Citation Authority
seo.description: High-authority setup requiring verified schema graphs (Article, Person, Org) and strict metadata limits.

guidelines.headingHierarchyRules: H1 with primary entity name, H2 with question + topical modifier, H3 with evidence and data attribution.
guidelines.sitemapGuidelines: Daily changefreq, lastmod ISO-8601 timestamps, image tags included.
guidelines.customRules: Structured credentials, publication date, reviewer bio, and statutory licenses must be declared in JSON-LD and page markup.

geo.name: Perplexity & ChatGPT Search Citation Master
geo.description: Engineered for AI answer engines with BLUF direct answers, authoritative statistics, and structured source anchors.

guidelines.llmCitationStrategy: Anchor authoritative source name, publication date, and methodology immediately following any numerical or regulatory claim.
guidelines.entityDensityAndSchema: Connect Primary Entity to parent Knowledge Graph entity using sameAs Wikidata and Crunchbase links.
guidelines.brandQuotationStandard: Incorporate verified corporate statements or executive quotes with credential attribution.
guidelines.sourceVerificationStyle: Direct inline citations linked to primary governmental, academic, or industry benchmark sources.
guidelines.customGeoRules: Inject high-density factual answers in the first 45 words of every major section.
guidelines.statDensityRequirement: At least 1 verified metric or statistic per 150 words of body content.
guidelines.directAnswerStandard: 40-50 word Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF) direct answers answering user search intent.
guidelines.sourceAttributionStandard: Formal regulatory, academic, or certified third-party audit reports.
guidelines.multiPerspectiveRequirement: Present structured comparison matrices or tables for LLM citation extraction.

customerCentricity.name: Empathetic Consumer & YMYL Transparency
customerCentricity.description: Designed for high-trust financial and sensitive decisions. Low cognitive load, proactive objection handling, and clear reassurance.

guidelines.targetCustomerPersona: Credit-conscious consumers and families navigating critical financial or life decisions.
guidelines.empathyAndTone: Reassuring, compassionate, transparent, and non-judgmental. Eliminate sales pressure.
guidelines.readingAccessibility: 8th-Grade layman readability (Flesch-Kincaid 60-70). Explain every financial/technical acronym immediately.
corePainPointsToAddress: Fear of hidden origination or processing fees
Anxiety about credit score hit during rate checks
Unclear repayment schedules or compounding interest
Unresponsive customer support during urgent disputes
frictionPatternsToFlag: Buried fee disclosures or asterisks without direct explanation
Aggressive countdown/false scarcity timers
Vague APR claims like "Rates as low as...*" without typical ranges
Complex run-on multi-clause sentences (>20 words)
Missing human contact phone or dispute assistance details
guidelines.decisionJourneyOrder: 1. Soft-Check Reassurance -> 2. Transparent Cost Calculator -> 3. Simple 3-Step Process -> 4. Clear FAQ & Human Support Access
objectionHandlingRules: Proactively explain eligibility if credit score is below average
Directly state there are zero penalties for early prepayment or payoff
Clarify state licensing, security standards, and FDIC/partner bank backing
trustAndReassuranceSignals: "No impact on credit score" soft check badge
256-bit SSL bank-grade security encryption
Dedicated toll-free human phone support with hours
BBB / Trustpilot verified rating badge
Full statutory licensing & APR disclosure block
guidelines.customCustomerRules: Every rate quote must display an illustrative APR example with representative loan terms and total repayment calculation.

structureMapping.name: High-Intent Commercial & Voice AEO Architecture
structureMapping.description: Structured for high search volume capture, single H1 anchor, conversational question H2/H3s, and direct AEO voice snippets.

guidelines.headingHierarchyRule: Strict single H1 topic anchor -> H2 major search-volume chapters -> H3 conversational voice queries. Never skip heading levels (no H2 directly into H4).
preferredSectionOrder: Frequent Voice Questions & Direct BLUF Answers (H2)
guidelines.searchIntentMappingStrategy: Primary high-volume commercial keywords mapped to H1 and first H2; secondary informational and voice question long-tail keywords mapped to H3 FAQ sections.
guidelines.keywordDistributionRules: Primary target keyword in H1, first paragraph, and at least one H2. Target secondary keywords distributed evenly across body sub-sections with no clustering.
guidelines.customStructureRules: Every question-based H2/H3 heading must be immediately followed by a concise 40-50 word direct answer paragraph suitable for voice assistants.
